recipe_title: Warm Cinnamon-Berry Greek Yogurt Bowls with Toasted Oats

details.title_candidate: Warm Cinnamon-Berry Greek Yogurt Bowls with Toasted Oats
details.flavour_profile: Sweet-tart, warmly spiced, creamy, and crunchy

warnings: Stage 4 coverage: 'Nonfat plain Greek yogurt': [330137] Yogurt, Greek, plain, nonfat has no USDA value for fiber_g (which would be summed as zero) — switched to [2705424] Yogurt, Greek, nonfat milk, plain.

details.summary: This is an outstanding, practical recipe that perfectly hits the brief: it delivers great temperature and texture contrast in under 10 minutes while hitting ideal protein, fiber, and carbohydrate targets with zero added sugar.

dimensions.feedback: The combination of tart berries, creamy yogurt, and warm spices with toasted oats creates a balanced and classic flavor profile.
All six ingredients are logically and accurately used in the step-by-step instructions exactly as listed.
Excellent instructions with clear time ranges (3 to 5 minutes, 1 to 2 minutes), midpoint checks, and explicit visual doneness cues ('golden and fragrant', 'hot and juicy').
Perfectly aligns with an American-style healthy snack or breakfast bowl.
Dry-toasting the oats and microwaving frozen berries for a quick compote are highly effective, reliable techniques for this application.
The computed macro values accurately reflect the ingredients, particularly the high protein from the nonfat Greek yogurt and the carbohydrate/fiber from the berries and oats.
The title and intro faithfully describe the dish and its quick execution without resorting to banned health claims or 'diet' language.
Highly appetizing. The contrast in temperatures (warm berries, cold yogurt) and textures (creamy base, crunchy oats) makes this a compelling snack.
Delivers exactly what the dual condition requires: lean protein, quality complex carbohydrates, and zero saturated fat or added sugars.
Sweetness relies honestly on the berries, cinnamon, and vanilla without syrups or honey. The oats provide a necessary, high-quality carbohydrate component.
Fits the Snacks & Sides chapter perfectly, hitting the targeted 10-24g carbohydrate window and providing an excellent 20.4g of satiating protein per serving.
Easily achievable in under 10 minutes total using universally available supermarket ingredients and basic equipment.
